purpose: Orient readers to teacher supervision, the learning contract, student experience, evaluation and deployment.
alt: Training combines task inputs, teacher supervision and student experience. Choose the signal, prefixes and objective, then update the student. Evaluate independent task outcomes and feed failures back into the recipe. Deployment uses the student without the teacher unless the product explicitly includes a larger-model path.
